sql.query:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (u.id) u.name,u.photo,u.phone,u.bio,u.location,u.custom_id,u.lat,u.lng,
    s.name AS service,s.slug AS service_slug,s.id AS service_id,ps.price,ps.price_unit,
    p.rating,p.user_id,p.availability,COALESCE(p.is_verified,$5) AS is_verified,p.verification_badge,
    COALESCE(p.kyc_status,$6) AS kyc_status , ST_Distance(u.geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($1,$2),$7)::geography, $8)/$9 AS postgis_distance_km
    FROM providers p JOIN users u ON p.user_id=u.id
    JOIN provider_services ps ON ps.provider_id=p.user_id AND ps.is_visible=$10
    JOIN services s ON s.id=ps.service_id WHERE p.status = $11 AND (ST_DWithin(u.geom,ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($1,$2),$12)::geography,$3,$13) OR u.geom IS NULL) AND (LOWER(s.slug)=LOWER($4) OR s.id::text=$4)
    ORDER BY u.id,ps.created_at ASC,ps.id ASC

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT $1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname=$2) AND EXISTS (
   SELECT $3 FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid=a.atttypid
   WHERE a.attrelid=to_regclass($4) AND a.attname=$5 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND t.typname=$6
  ) AND EXISTS (SELECT $7 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid=to_regclass($8) AND tgname=$9 AND tgenabled!=$10) AS supported
SELECT proj4text, auth_name, auth_srid, srtext FROM public.spatial_ref_sys WHERE srid = $1 LIMIT $2
